title: Ingestion lifecycle
content: NeuroFlow accepts documents through the POST /ingest/file endpoint using multipart form data. The API validates the file name, MIME type, file signature, metadata JSON, and maximum upload size before persisting the source. The maximum file size is 25 MiB. A successful request returns HTTP 202 with an ingestion_id and queued status. An ARQ background worker extracts content, creates chunks, optionally generates embeddings, persists the chunks, and updates the document status to complete. Clients can poll GET /ingest/{document_id} to check status. The status endpoint only returns documents owned by the authenticated client.
